workflow: Recycling helps to reduce the effects of many environmental issues, such as climate change, air and water pollution, resource depletion, and habitat destruction. Through recycling, valuable materials and energy are conserved and resources are reduced, which all results in less energy consumption and fewer greenhouse gas emissions.
